items.title: Chat portals
items.text: Give an assistant its own page or put it on your website, with its own profile, look, limits, and visitors, and read how it's used.

items.title: Keep an assistant on topic
items.text: Say what an assistant covers and what it never discusses, and Enforce checks each question and answer, with a report of what it held.

items.title: Reach your computer from anywhere
items.text: Turn on access from anywhere and your devices keep working away from home, through your router or a relay, encrypted end to end.

items.title: Your computer, on your phone
items.text: The Toskar app shows your computer's notifications and automations, manages its memories and personalization, and shows what left it.

items.title: Save to Knowledge from anywhere
items.text: Share a web page, PDF, or text to Toskar on your phone, and chats on your computer answer from it.

items.title: Try again and edit, with versions
items.text: Try an answer again, with another model if you like, or edit what you sent, and switch between the versions.

items.title: Add any GGUF model
items.text: Add a model from a GGUF file on your computer or another device, checked with a short test of its speed.
